name: core-move-crimson-over-range
description: Rules audit (core, TI4_MOVE_CHECK): the over-range refusal also holds in a Crimson Rebellion game. Base pbd117@45: the Crimson home (br) has only an inactive breach, so an Arborec cruiser (move 2) at 301 is 7 systems away: moving it in is refused (gate32 pbd1682 saw this as a false refusal; it is the rule - the Sundered scenario now opens breaches first).
